scope: Descriptive properties of extracted and matched database records
review: Independent agent recomputation and claim-source check; root revision and visual review

claims.claim: Different AR6 citation-age roles of reused and incoming IDs
New AR6 IDs mostly appear in outlets represented in matched AR5
Incoming AR6 outlets are less concentrated than reused cohort outlets
Cross-group sharing has different union and smaller-cohort denominators

terminology.paper: Database paper ID, treated as a record identity
terminology.reference occurrence: Extracted reference entry linked to a catalogue unit
terminology.matched cohort: At least one matched_doi or matched_title occurrence in the given report
terminology.journal: Normalized outlet-title label, without subject classification
terminology.incoming: AR6 IDs absent from the report-specific matched AR5 set
terminology.previously represented outlet: identical normalized named label present in matched AR5
terminology.within-group retention: matched intersection within the same working group across AR5–AR6
terminology.overlap coefficient: shared IDs divided by the smaller working-group set

reference_verification_scope: All 23 bibliography records pass DOI/metadata verification; claims have primary-source locators and explicit reading scopes in literature_sources.json.
